blocks.content: Write a program to remove elements from a vector.

items: Initialize a string vector called languages with the elements C++, Python, and Java.
Remove the second element (index 1) from the vector.
Then, print the vector again in a new line.

blocks.content: Hint: Use the erase() function to remove the element.
